title: Dripito — Open-Source IV Drip Flow Monitor (Rev-B)
description:
A single-AA-cell intravenous-infusion flow-rate monitor for pediatric care in resource-constrained clinical settings. Custom STM32G0 PCB, optical dual-beam drop detection, monochrome graphic LCD, piezo alarm, and ASA-printed enclosure. Designed and built as an MSc semester project at ETH Zürich Global Health Engineering, 2026.

Includes firmware, hardware schematics (KiCad), enclosure CAD, and bench-validation data. Project page: https://gluflex.github.io/dripito.
